why: A 0-1 BFS with the weight on the node instead of the edge: leaving a broken country costs one repair day, leaving a working one costs 0. Front-push 0-cost moves and back-push 1-cost moves on a deque.
hints: Teleporting is free, but some departures cost a day. Put that cost on each edge: what is the weight of a -> b?
Weight(a -> b) = 1 if a is broken, else 0. Edge weights 0 and 1 mean 0-1 BFS.
Deque from source with dist 0; when relaxing edges out of u use w = broken[u]; appendleft on w = 0, append on w = 1. Return dist[destination] or -1; source == destination is 0.
pitfalls: Arriving at a broken country is free; only departing from it costs.
Duplicate entries in broken or repeated edges change nothing; a boolean array handles both.
